Distribution. The species is known only from Central China (Prov. Hubei, Prov. Sichuan), Southeast China (Prov. Guangdong, Prov. Fujian, Prov. Zhejiang) and Northern Laos (Prov. Luang Prabang). Note. Pseudacronicta omihsiensis shows some variability both externally and genitalically. In male genitalia, the three figured specimens have subtle differences in the shape of harpe, the shape of valvae and the fine structure of the claw-like sclerotized extension of costa. In female genitalia, specimen from Laos shows subtle differences in the proportion of the ductus and corpus bursae relative to the two Chinese specimens.
